title: Yogish Profile
content: Yogish is a Cloud and DevOps Engineer working with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD systems and automation. His current focus areas include Cloud Infrastructure, DevOps and CI/CD, AI Engineering, Agentic AI and Platform Engineering.

title: Accenture Experience
content: Yogish works at Accenture in a Cloud and DevOps role. His work involves CI/CD infrastructure and Jenkins / CloudBees environments, including managed controllers, agents, AWS infrastructure and automation. Technologies associated with this experience include Jenkins, CloudBees CI, AWS, GitHub and CI/CD.

title: AI SRE Platform
content: AI SRE Platform is an agentic AI system being built by Yogish to investigate CI/CD incidents, analyze failures, gather evidence and assist with safe remediation. The planned technology stack includes LangGraph, Jenkins, AWS and Kubernetes.

title: AI Portfolio Agent
content: AI Portfolio Agent is an AI-native personal portfolio capable of answering questions about Yogish's experience, skills, projects and technical work using grounded personal knowledge. The project uses a Next.js frontend, FastAPI backend and Gemini, with RAG and LangGraph planned.

title: GraphicCore AI
content: GraphicCore AI is a planned AI-powered discovery platform for manga, manhwa, manhua and light novels. The concept includes intelligent recommendations and technologies such as AI, RAG, React and Python.
